question: What is JPMorgan's expected net income and net interest income guidance for next year, and its exact market share in U.S. deposits?
uncited_claims: A data quality note reports 52 duplicate facts with conflicting values were set aside during parsing; this obs

answer.summary: JPMorgan's FY2023 net income was $49.55B [F00078], reported as $49.6 billion with EPS of $16.23, ROE of 17% and ROTCE of 21% [T00958]. Management guidance for next year covers net interest income of approximately $90 billion, market dependent [T01008], and net interest income excluding Markets of approximately $88 billion, market dependent [T01009]. However, no net income guidance for next year appears in the retrieved evidence. Likewise, no exact market share figure for U.S. deposits is present in the evidence.

key_numbers.metric: Next-year net interest income excluding Markets guidance

drivers: Net interest income guidance of ~$90B is the only forward-looking income metric provided; it is described as market dependent [T01008].
Net interest income excluding Markets guidance of ~$88B provides a segment-level view of the NII outlook [T01009].
FY2023 net interest income of $18.73B [F03302] is the actual base against which the ~$90B guidance is framed.
risks_and_red_flags: No net income guidance for next year is disclosed in the retrieved evidence; only net interest income guidance is provided.
No exact market share in U.S. deposits is disclosed in the retrieved evidence.
Net interest income guidance is explicitly 'market dependent', meaning it is sensitive to interest rate movements [T01008].
